key_components.description: Fixed canvas component streaming characters '01WEBPY' in #00FFAA with 0.15 opacity, slow speed, 14px monospace font, and trail fade rgba(5,7,10,0.1) behind the hero section.
Sticky navigation header with backdrop-blur-xl, glowing cyan diamond logo icon, links (Inicio, Servicios, Portafolio, Nosotros, Precios, Contacto), and 'Hablemos' CTA button with neon border.

Hero section with typewriter title 'TU IDEA, NUESTRA CREACION' featuring a blinking cyan cursor, cyan gradient text, subtitle, action buttons ('Empezar proyecto' & 'Ver portfolio'), and right-side 3D floating laptop CSS mockup with code dashboard visual.
High impact metrics bar displaying stats such as +50 Proyectos, 99.8% Satisfacción, 24/7 Automatización IA, and 3.5x Retorno Inversión.
Interactive grid displaying 3 core service cards: 1) Diseño UI/UX, 2) Desarrollo Web React Next.js, 3) Automatización IA Chatbots, with neon cyan borders and hover glow.
Interactive portfolio gallery with 2 detailed CSS website mockups (Mariachis Demo & Fotógrafo Demo) featuring live interactive tabs, responsive device toggles, and preview modals.
3-tier pricing table (Básico $299, Pro $599 'Más Popular', Empresa $999+) with detailed feature list and instant quote CTA.
Floating chat widget at bottom-left with quick replies for 'Restaurante', 'Tienda', and 'Servicios' that launch custom WhatsApp prefilled messages.
Floating green WhatsApp button at bottom-right with continuous ring pulse animation for instant contact.
Agency footer with 'Síguenos' social links (Instagram, LinkedIn, GitHub, X), Paraguay contact info, service links, and copyright.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete single-page agency application in React with modular components inside src/components/.
Implement the MatrixRain canvas component with exact character string '01WEBPY', #00FFAA color at 0.15 opacity, monospace font 14px, and smooth fade trail.
Implement the typewriter text effect for 'TU IDEA, NUESTRA CREACION' in the hero section using pure React hooks or Framer Motion typing animation with blinking cyan cursor '|'.
Build the 3D floating laptop visual in pure CSS (perspective, rotateY, transform-style 3d) showing a stylized web development code dashboard with animated typing lines and glowing neon borders.
Ensure the navbar is sticky with backdrop-blur-xl and contains the glowing diamond icon next to 'WEB CREATOR PY'.

Create the 2 portfolio cards with rich CSS website mockups: 'Mariachis Demo' (featuring mariachi band booking dashboard) and 'Fotógrafo Demo' (featuring photography dark gallery layout). Include interactive demo toggles or modal view.
Add the floating green WhatsApp pulse button on bottom-right and the interactive Chatbot Bubble on bottom-left with quick replies ('Restaurante', 'Tienda', 'Servicios').
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like transition: all. Always specify transition target properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp neon bordered buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 for icons — use lucide-react icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, glow effects, and entrance animations.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
